# Duzup

> Duzup is a free, open-source, fully offline reminder app for Android. It keeps bills, events, tasks, notes, birthdays and routines in one place and sends heads-up notifications at the right time. No account, no ads, no analytics, no internet permission.

Duzup is for people who want one calm place for everything they need to remember, without handing their data to a cloud service. It runs entirely on the phone. It is distributed as a signed APK through GitHub Releases (MIT license). It is Android only (Android 8.0 or newer) and has no cloud sync.

## Key facts
- Platform: Android 8.0+ (API 26). No iOS or web app.
- Price: free. License: MIT. Source code is public.
- Privacy: no account, no server, no analytics, no ads, no INTERNET permission. Data stays in app-private storage. Backups are plain JSON files the user saves themselves.
- Reminder types: bills, events, tasks, notes, birthdays, routines.
- Notifications: heads-up banner with sound and vibration on by default, snooze (10 min, 1 h, 3 h, tomorrow morning), quiet hours, per-type actions, restored after reboot.
- Quick add: typing "call mom tomorrow 6pm" picks the kind, date and time automatically (offline parser).
